verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is enterprise infrastructure release pinning: customers choose when to adopt a new release, stay on their selected version, and can canary-test new releases (bland-docs-14, bland-docs-31). That gives some version stability, but it is not documented as API versioning and appears limited to enterprise isolated infrastructure. Pathway draft/production versioning concerns agent configuration rather than the API itself. Missing for 10: explicitly versioned API endpoints or version headers, a documented deprecation policy with timelines, changelog/sunset notices, availability beyond enterprise tiers, and any independent corroboration.
